themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles discussing AI agents performing research tasks autonomously or semi-autonomously, including data collection, analysis, and interaction with research participants.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Content focused on AI tools that assist developers in writing, reviewing, and debugging code, including security implications and efficiency.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Tools and platforms that leverage AI to support various stages of the research process, from data gathering to analysis and reporting.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: AI applications that condense large amounts of text, such as earnings calls, meeting notes, and research papers, into concise summaries.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: The creation and use of artificial user representations for testing, research, and simulation purposes.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: The application of AI in testing the usability of products and systems, including automated checks and evaluations.

themes.name: AI qualitative research
themes.description: AI's role in qualitative research methods, such as interview analysis, thematic identification, and understanding nuanced human responses.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Utilizing AI to analyze and understand customer sentiment and feedback from various sources like social media and reviews.

themes.name: AI survey tools
themes.description: AI-powered tools designed to assist in the creation, distribution, analysis, and optimization of surveys.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: The intersection of AI and the design process, including AI's impact on design workflows, tools, and creative decision-making.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
